# gemini-web-mcp
> Agent-first MCP Python SDK v2 gateway and skills for Gemini Web workflows, Deep Research & NotebookLM.

Gemini Web MCP exposes Gemini Web capabilities to MCP-compatible clients such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Desktop, VS Code MCP clients, and Antigravity.

## Documentation
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/README.md): High-level overview, architecture, and client configuration.
- [Quickstart Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/docs/quickstart.md): Environment setup, cookie configuration, and MCP server launch.
- [Tools Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/docs/tools.md): Complete list of tools in the Function and Account catalogs.
- [API Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/docs/api-reference.md): Low-level MCP contract schemas and response data structures.
- [Notebook & Task Workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/docs/notebook-task-workflows.md): Managing NotebookLM integrations and background execution.
- [Troubleshooting & FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/docs/faq.md): Cookie refresh, session timeouts, and security considerations.
- [Full Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated reference documentation including tool contracts and schemas.

## Optional
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/docs/architecture.md): MCP Python SDK v2 dual-surface architecture.

- [Smithery Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Luckycat133/gemini-web-mcp/main/smithery.yaml): Registry configuration for Smithery.ai CLI and 1-click installation.
